figurative_meaning_en: to scold harshly; to reprimand severely
example_sentences_in_bangla: বাবা ছেলেকে কড়া ঝাড় দিয়েছে ভুলের জন্য।
শিক্ষক ক্লাসে অশৃঙ্খল ছাত্রকে ঝাড় দিলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The father gave the son a harsh scolding for his mistake.
The teacher reprimanded the unruly student in class.
note: This idiom evokes the image of vigorously sweeping away dirt, metaphorically clearing away misbehavior through verbal rebuke.
